The graph does not label build vs test edges; setuptools/wheel build requirements are absent from it (omission). mypy is the one riscv64-relevant item (test extra only).

Open unreviewed CI modernization raising cibuildwheel to 4.3.5 and editing the same release.yml matrix lines; riscv64 work should build on it.
Downstream riscv64 wheel build merged; dropped test extras because mypy has no riscv64 wheel.

data.summary: immutables 0.21 ships x86_64/aarch64 (cibuildwheel 2.21.3, QEMU) plus macOS and Windows wheels but no riscv64. It is a single plain-C setuptools extension with no native dependencies, so riscv64 is a pure CI matrix change in .github/workflows/release.yml. Downstream wheels already exist (python-wheels #1045). No upstream riscv64 discussion exists; open PR #124 bumps cibuildwheel and edits the same lines.
